title: apricity-daw warp.rs: warp markers and warp mode for each pad's region
description:
## Intent

Pads warp the way Apricity warps them: a sample with a beat grid carries its warp markers into the sampler, so the rack plays the slices at the DAW's tempo; a sample without one plays unwarped.

## Scope

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/warp.rs`: map `rhythm.warp_markers` (seconds -> beat, beat 0 = first downbeat, pickups negative) to the DAW's warp marker list, clipped to the pad's region with a marker at each end (interpolated); warp mode from the clip's `warp` (beats / complex / texture / repitch) using the mode table from the M0 notes.
- Shared with the sidecar initiative (apricitus-d7746d) and the set export (apricitus-6edba8): if one of them already wrote this mapping, reuse it and add only the region clipping.
- A sample whose manifest has no beats (`rhythm.bpm` null) or a clip with `warp repitch`: warp off.

## Out of scope

Tempo automation (Apricity scores have one tempo).

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw
```
The warp scenarios of `features/daw/kit-preset.feature` pass; unit tests cover a pickup (negative beat), a region that starts between two markers, and a sample with drifting tempo (markers not evenly spaced).

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): warp markers for kit pads`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the rack writer task. Relates to the warp marker mapping in apricitus-d7746d.
